How to Register a Vendor in CPS

A simple, step-by-step guide for the Procurement team

Please read first. From now on, a new vendor can be added only through Vendor Registration. The old “add vendor” buttons (in Suppliers, RFQ, Quotes, Work Orders, Invoice Upload…) now bring you here. A new vendor must be approved before you can raise a Purchase Order for them.

Vendors you already work with keep working as normal — there is no rush and their POs are not blocked.

The 3 ways to add a vendor

All three start from the same place — Vendor Registration in the left menu. Pick whichever is easiest.

1 · You fill it
Fastest when you already have the vendor’s papers.
2 · Send a link
The vendor fills their own details on their phone.
3 · Printable form
For a vendor with no smartphone — print / WhatsApp a form.

WAY 1You fill in the vendor yourself

1

Start a new vendor

Click New vendor. Choose the vendor type (it decides which documents are needed). Type the vendor’s legal name. Click Start.

2

Fill the vendor’s details

Fill the boxes — name, GST, PAN, address, the three contacts, and bank details. There is no Save button — each box saves on its own when you move to the next one.

3

Upload the documents

For each document, click Attach and choose the file (photo or PDF). The counter at the top — e.g. 1 of 6 — shows how many are done. A green Attached tag means it is uploaded.

4

Add the site-visit proof

Add a photo of the vendor’s shop/office with its location, and a photo with the vendor. This section is internal — the vendor never sees it. (The second photo can be skipped with a written reason using Waiver.)

5

Accept terms & submit

Type the name of the person at the vendor who agreed to the terms and click Record acceptance. When everything is done, click Submit for verification. The grey text tells you what is still missing.

WAY 2Send the vendor a link

The vendor fills their own details — more accurate, and no typing for you.

1

Copy the vendor link

Open the vendor (or start a new one, Way 1 step 1). Click Vendor link at the top. Copy the link and send it to the vendor on WhatsApp. The link works once and expires in 7 days.

2

The vendor fills their form

The vendor opens the link on any phone or computer — no login needed. They see this simple form (already showing their name) and fill their own details and bank information.

3

Vendor submits, then you finish

The vendor uploads their documents, types their name to accept the terms, and clicks Submit registration. After that, you add the site-visit photos (Way 1, step 4) and press Submit for verification.

WAY 3Give the vendor a printable form

For a vendor who cannot use the link (no smartphone / not comfortable online).

1

Download the offline form

On the vendor, click Offline form. A ready-to-print form opens in English + Hindi. Use your browser’s Print ▸ Save as PDF and send it on WhatsApp, or print it on paper. The vendor fills it by hand and returns it with copies of the documents — then you enter it using Way 1.

What happens after you submit?

The verifier checks the documents and approves the vendor. Only then can a Purchase Order be raised for that vendor.

You can follow the status: draft → pending verification → approved

Tip — your work list. The Dashboard shows “N vendors you trade with are not registered.” These are older vendors that have orders but no registration yet. Register them when you get time, so their future POs are never blocked. Click Register next to any of them to start.
